title: 第一卷 第25章 这陈玄或许是个人才第一卷 第26章 陈玄的拳力
lines: “大夫人，冷静！”陈玄连忙说道。
林婉却没有理会陈玄，又是过去了一段时间，陈玄感觉自己累得不行了，他在床上，沉沉的睡了过去！
林婉的脑袋靠在了陈玄的胸膛上道：“小家伙，如果你说的真能成了，将军府，可就欠你一个大恩情！”
是的，将军府出了财政问题，而且问题还不小。
自秦烨战死以来，将军府旗下的产业不断的被挤压抢夺，朝廷也是睁一只眼闭一只眼！
加上跟随秦烨南征北战，死了许多人，秦烨都会给其家属补贴，这个补贴是每个月都在给，是一笔巨大的开销！
这让得整个将军府的财政，逐渐的开始捉襟见肘了起来。
“王奎！”林婉淡淡的说道：“等我度过这次的危机，这笔账，我好好的跟你算一算！”
说着，她从床上坐了起来。
穿戴完毕之后，她推门而出！
“小昭！”林婉开口。
小昭迅速的迎了过来道：“夫人，那陈玄…怎么在床榻上睡着了！”
“今夜就让他在这里睡便是了！”林婉说道：“明日陈玄要出去看铺子，届时你带着我的令牌与他一同前往便可！”
“是！”小昭点头！
“你记得观察，他所有的行为，包括所说的话，回来之后详细说与我听！”林婉又是提醒道。
“啊！”小昭一愣。
“这陈玄，或许是个人才！”林婉转身看着酣睡的陈玄，眼眸之中，露出了一丝的异样。
小昭点头道：“是的，夫人！”
一夜，悄然无息的流逝了过去！
第二天一大早，陈玄还是早早的便醒来了。
之前的他，还以为是每日被切菜的声音吵醒，现在看来，这本身便是陈玄自身的一个生物钟！
他看了看躺在自己身边的林婉，林婉睡觉看起来也非常的恬静。
“如果能够每天都睡这儿就好了！”陈玄心中喃喃的道。
对于林婉这种级别的美女，他的心里还是有些觊觎的。
他默默的摇了摇头，收起自己的心思，然后他蹑手蹑脚的想要走出去。
“早些把早餐送过来，然后回后厨等着！”林婉依然闭着眼睛，但是声音却响了起来道：“小昭到时候会随你一同去看铺子。”
陈玄心中一顿，然后他点头道：“好的，大夫人。”
等了片刻，见林婉没有出声，陈玄才小心翼翼的离开了！
返回后厨，他便迅速的开始忙碌了起来。
同时陈玄发现，自己的体质，在昨晚之后，似乎又是有着提升。
看来林婉所言非虚，与她双修，确实是对自己有好处。
content_en:
;;
"Madam, calm down!" Chen Xuan said quickly.
Lin Wan ignored Chen Xuan. After some time passed, Chen Xuan felt that he was extremely tired. He fell into a deep sleep on the bed!
Lin Wan rested her head on Chen Xuan's chest and said, "Little guy, if what you say comes true, the General's Mansion will owe you a big favor!"
Yes, the general's government has financial problems, and the problems are not small.
Since Qin Ye's death in battle, the properties under the General's Mansion have been squeezed and robbed, and the court has turned a blind eye!
In addition, many people died while following Qin Ye in the north and south. Qin Ye would give subsidies to their families. This subsidy was given every month, which was a huge expense!
This made the finances of the entire General Mansion gradually begin to be stretched.
"Wang Kui!" Lin Wan said calmly: "When I get through this crisis, I will settle this account with you!"
With that said, she sat up from the bed.
After finishing dressing, she pushed open the door and walked out!
"Xiao Zhao!" Lin Wan said.
Xiao Zhao quickly came over and said, "Madam, why did Chen Xuan... fall asleep on the bed?"
"Just let him sleep here tonight!" Lin Wan said: "Tomorrow Chen Xuan will go out to look at the shop. Then you can go with him with my token!"
"Yes!" Xiao Zhao nodded!
"Remember to observe all his actions, including what he said, and tell me in detail when he comes back!" Lin Wan reminded again.
"Ah!" Xiao Zhao was stunned.
"This Chen Xuan may be a talent!" Lin Wan turned around and looked at Chen Xuan, who was sleeping soundly. There was something strange in his eyes.
Xiao Zhao nodded and said: "Yes, madam!"
…
One night passed quietly!
Early the next morning, Chen Xuan woke up early.
Before, he thought he was woken up by the sound of chopping vegetables every day. Now it seems that this is Chen Xuan's own biological clock!
He looked at Lin Wan who was lying next to him. Lin Wan looked very peaceful while sleeping.
"It would be great if I could sleep here every day!" Chen Xuan murmured in his heart.
He still coveted a beauty of Lin Wan's level.
He shook his head silently, put away his thoughts, and then he tiptoed to walk out.
"Send breakfast over earlier, and then go back to the kitchen and wait!" Lin Wan still closed her eyes, but her voice sounded louder: "Xiao Zhao will go to the shop with you then."
Chen Xuan paused in his heart, then nodded and said: "Okay, madam."
After waiting for a moment and seeing that Lin Wan didn't make a sound, Chen Xuan left cautiously!
Returning to the kitchen, he quickly started busy.
At the same time, Chen Xuan discovered that his physique seemed to have improved after last night.
It seems that what Lin Wan said is true. It is indeed good for him to practice dual cultivation with her.
